title: C2a: content pointer via posting-key-signed manifest chain (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: the DID document carries a stable service entry naming the operator's content endpoint and the delegated posting key; the operator serves the latest RootManifest signed by the posting key, each with a sequence number and the CID of the previous manifest (a chain). Readers verify the posting key is listed in the DID document, the signature, monotonic sequence, and chain links; clients remember the highest sequence seen to detect stale serving. The DID log changes only when operator or posting key changes. Refines C2.
